This is my best-guess assembly. I could not confirm some of the connections from the part drawings alone, so the placements below rest on inferences that I have not checked against the grader.

**Pillar and base.** The pillar's flat end sits on the centre pad of the base, whose top is at y=5, and its round head carries the beam. I rotated the pillar by −109.9° so it stands vertical, with the head centre at (688, 105).

**Beam and pointer.** The beam pivots on the pillar head, so its hub circle sits at (688, 105). I rotated it by −54.74° so the two end hooks are level and the pivot sits above them, as on a real beam. The pointer shares the same hub, rotated −124.7° so the long needle hangs down in front of the pillar.

**Stirrups and pans.** This is the shakiest part of the guess. I hung each stirrup from the beam end by its small curl hook, so its bar runs down to the big C-shaped ring at the bottom. I then placed each pan so the rectangular slot in its lower band sits at that ring's centre. I rotated both pans (−34.8° and −70°) so the rim is level. The opposite assignment, with the big ring at the beam, would put the stirrup features at the wrong ends.

I made no scaling or mirroring changes, and each part is used once.
